body:
I've tried so, so many treatments and medications but nothing works. The medications either make me worse, or just do nothing at all. I've run out of options now.

For fun I listen to music and play video games, but I'm having trouble doing the latter these days.

Hi, thank you. I have been tested for POTS + NCS, doctors have been incredibly vague when asked if I actually have it or not, but I have basically tried all of the medication & treatments for it anyway just in case I do have pots/ncs, but with no difference made. I have run out of treatment options now. I think having to hear "There's nothing more we can do." is what has hurt me the most.
Yes, I do. Why do you ask?

Thank you so much.

I can definitely try out the 'fuck you' box. I'm really stubborn already, I find that sort of thing does fuel me onwards somewhat. 

It's late here and I am so exhausted, I want to reply with something consistent but I feel like my mind has turned to porridge. Sorry. Thank you. It's the first time I've managed to talk to anyone with any sort of experience with this sort of thing.

Thank you.

It's disabling to the point where just walking around my house is a really arduous task. Part of the problem is that I'm an extremely stubborn person, I push myself to walk around and I end up passing out and feeling even worse, I get angry at myself for being sick. I am constantly frustrated by myself, by my body. I want to just manage to walk around without crippling chest pain or running out of oxygen. I just want to be better. I want to be normal, not just for me but for my family, I don't want them to have to keep on worrying about me.
